_comment: The catalog descriptions are the source of truth for prerequisites.
This file records the few facts the prose omits, and — just as important —
the edges from the app's old hand-written table that were NOT adopted, with
the reason. Keeping the rejections visible stops them being silently
re-added the next time the two lists are compared.

add_edges.why: MATH 20B's description calls itself the second course in the sequence but never names 20A as a prerequisite.
MATH 189 lists MATH 18 and MATH 180A; the department also requires MATH 20C, which the text omits.

rejected_edges.why: Linear algebra does not require second-quarter calculus. Present in the old hand-written table; unsupported by the catalog.
Redundant. CSE 151A requires a programming background, and CSE 12 already satisfies that group.
Redundant. Covered by the <probability> group, which MATH 180A satisfies.
CSE 15L lists no prerequisite in the catalog.
Modelled instead as the <qualifying elective> group, so DSC 140B and DSC 148 count equally rather than all three being required.
